text.text_excerpt: Absolutely loved this place. This is a great local bar where the bartenders and patrons all know each other and are willing to have a nice chat with the visitors wandering in. Picture Cheers - NOLA style. This was one of my favorite Bloody Mary's during my trip - right amount of zing with an array of fabulous additions, like olives and pickled green beans. Drinks are inexpensive and not lacking in strength. Yes, a gay bar, but equal crowd and I definitely felt welcome. Cash only but an ATM is on hand. This place is on my must return to list, for my next visit.

This place is so awesome. It's a gay bar, yes. But, it's not one that reeks of exclusiveness or intolerance. The lantern is so laid back and really fun to hang out in. They have lots of events (talent shows, benefits for their patrons, drag shows), as well as a comfortable atmosphere that's easy to relax in. The bartenders love to have a good time and aren't stuffy or snobby. They pour hard and keep 'em coming. I might also note that the cleanest bathroom in the French Quarter award belongs to this place.

Great bloody mary's. Wonderful bartenders. I had to update my review. This place is wonderful. The bartenders really get to know you and you get to know them. I take my dog to the dog park almost on a daily basis and he always b-lines it for the bar. The bartenders all give him treats. What you would think of a gay bar take this one and throw it out the window. This place is honestly like cheers. It is where the locals all go to talk and hang out to get away from Bourbon st. Everytime I go I meet someone new and it seems that this is the place to be to meet everyone around the neighborhood.
